name: fallow
description: Codebase intelligence for TypeScript and JavaScript using fallow

interface.longDescription: Fallow gives Codex fast, local codebase analysis for TypeScript and JavaScript. Audit changed-code risk, find dead code and unused dependencies, detect duplication and complexity hotspots, inspect architecture boundaries, and prioritize safe cleanup. Fallow Impact explains the latest full-project issue count, its comparable trend, and findings cleared while tracking.
defaultPrompt: Audit this codebase for changed-code risk and cleanup opportunities.
Review this branch with fallow and prioritize what needs attention.
Show the latest Fallow Impact summary for this project.
